title: Does Analogue 3D really make retro games 4K? Here's what you should know - Engadget
summary: The Analogue 3D does a great job at upscaling old N64 games, with a few caveats. According to Analogue, it's compatible with every original N64 game, though its official hardware is not designed to support ROM files.
